en.title: GTA 6 Soundtrack Ignites Spotify: Music Streams Skyrocket Past 130,000%
en.summary: The cultural behemoth that is **Grand Theft Auto VI** is having an unexpected, massive impact on music streaming platforms. Fans are diving deep into the game's audio landscape, leading to astronomical surges in plays for songs both new and decades old.
en.body:
The launch of **Grand Theft Auto VI** has not only shattered video game sales records but has also sent shockwaves through the music industry. Spotify has revealed staggering data showcasing immense spikes in streams for songs featured in the game, with some tracks experiencing increases well over 130,000%.

This phenomenon isn't limited to newly composed music for the game. Classics are being rediscovered and celebrated by a new generation of players. Notably, **Captain & Tennille's** "But I Think It’s A Dream" saw an astonishing 130,730% increase in global streams and an almost unbelievable 885,400% surge in playlist additions following the game's release. Similarly, **Tom Petty's** "Love Is A Long Road," featured in the initial **GTA VI** trailer, saw its streams climb from 15 million to 36.5 million within two months, eventually becoming the late singer-songwriter's sixth most popular track. Other artists experiencing significant boosts include **Bob Moses and Elderbrook** with "Inner Light," which saw a 1070% increase in plays and a 4155% rise in playlist additions, and **Chimbala & Omega's** "Se Me Nota (Agárrame),” which experienced a 10,190% jump in plays. Even **Depeche Mode's** "People Are People" saw a notable 190% increase in plays and a 700% jump in playlist additions.

The **GTA VI Extended Look** trailer alone was a powerful catalyst, driving significant growth for its musical selections. The official soundtrack album, **'GTA VI: THE ALBUM'**, also set a new Spotify record, achieving 29.85 million first-day streams, highlighting the immense anticipation and engagement surrounding the game's audio presentation.

## The Soundtrack's Cultural Resonance

This massive uptick in music consumption underscores the profound connection players forge with the audio elements of **Grand Theft Auto**. It’s a testament to Rockstar Games' meticulous approach to soundtrack curation, where music isn't just background noise but an integral part of the narrative and world-building. The fact that a 2015 Carly Rae Jepsen song, "Run Away With Me," experienced a 940% stream increase globally and 1,255% in Canada, simply by appearing in a pivotal moment, speaks volumes about the game's power to reignite interest in beloved tracks.

Fans aren't just passively listening; they're actively seeking out and curating these songs. Spotify's data also shows a 510% global and 600% U.S. surge in searches containing "GTA," "GTA6/VI," or "Grand Theft Auto" in the week following the game's release. This indicates a deep dive by the community into the game's universe, extending beyond the gameplay itself to its rich sonic tapestry. The official **GTA 6** playlist has also seen streams surge by 275% globally and 355% in the U.S. week-over-week.

## What's Next

As **Grand Theft Auto VI** continues to dominate headlines and break records, it's clear its influence on music discovery and consumption will persist. Players will undoubtedly continue to explore the game's soundtrack, leading to further discoveries and potentially more unexpected chart successes for artists across genres and eras. The long-term impact on streaming trends and artist visibility remains to be seen, but the initial data points to a powerful synergy between gaming and music.

content_raw: Spotify has released new data that shows huge spikes in streams for music featured in GTA 6 , including a Carly Rae Jepsen song from over a decade ago. In an email sent to IGN, Spotify revealed that the GTA 6 hype is inspiring listeners to add tons of music from the game to their playlists. In addition to hype for the original music created specifically for the game, such as Justice's Flower in a Hurricane, Carly Rae Jepsen's 2015 song Run Away With Me saw a 940% increase in streams following the game's release. The song plays during a pivotal moment in GTA 6's first chapter and is arguably one of the best sections in the game. Additionally, fans are listening to the official GTA 6 playlist en masse and are actively searching for things related to the game. You can view the full breakdown courtesy of Spotify below. Following the release of GTA 6, streams of Carly Rae Jepsen's “Run Away With Me” spiked on Nov. 24, increasing by 940% in the U.S. and 1,255% in Canada compared to its average streams. On Nov. 23, “Flower In A Hurricane” by Justice, Tame Impala, SZA and King Gizzard & the Lizard Wizard hit number 1 on BOTH Spotify’s Daily Top Songs charts globally and in the U.S. Streams of The Official Grand Theft Auto Playlist surged week over week, rising 275% globally and 355% in the U.S. (on Nov. 19 as compared to Nov. 12). GTA had fans searching for more. Searches containing “GTA,” “GTA6/VI” or “Grand Theft Auto” surged about 510% globally and 600% in the U.S. compared with the week prior (Nov. 19 vs. Nov. 12). GTA 6 has been shattering all kinds of records and setting new trends. The game had the biggest launch in the history of PlayStation and sold nearly $4 billion worth of copies in its first 24 hours , making it the highest-grossing entertainment launch of all time by a significant s a massive cultural moment that's likely not going to end anytime soon. Not only will this game likely get bigger, but it also has more big events on the horizon.
